messages:
mira: Heads-up 10am call with Redwood pilot team + AcmePay. They want streaming SDK -> function-calls for enrichment -> newline-delimited JSON output to their on-prem parser. Must use customer-managed KMS/HSM and provide SOC2 excerpts before pilot. Any immediate blockers?

alex: Streaming + function_calls supported in our SDKs (node/python/go). Main friction = their reverse proxy removes Authorization headers. Two paths: mTLS between their proxy and our Private ingress, or ephemeral signed URLs that the proxy allows.

judy: Pricing note: they mentioned ~15 qps, ~120 tokens in, ~600 tokens out. Streaming long outputs + function-calls will raise token usage; recommend reserved capacity forecast with 20% buffer. I can post 3 scenarios (on-demand, 6mo reserved, 12mo reserved) by EOD.

prashant: For strict JSON-lines use the structured-output binding + runtime schema enforcement. Prompt suffix we give: "Return exactly one JSON object per line with keys id (string), verdict (string), score (number), meta (object). No extra text." Also turn on strict_mode in the runtime so nonconforming items are rejected.

mira: They require HSM attestation and cert rotation policy. @sec-bot can we assemble a minimal compliance bundle for procurement?

sec-bot: SOC2 Type II available. KMS: we support customer-managed keys via KMIP/Azure/AWS for Private; HSM attestation depends on vendor but we can accept vendor-signed attestations or federate. Cert rotation: runtime certs rotate daily; customer cert rotation cadence configurable. Compliance ticket created: INC-9012. ETA 48h for initial bundle.

alex: Effort estimate: mTLS path ~3 eng days + infra coordination; ephemeral-signed-URL path ~1 eng day + docs.

prashant: Quick Node example for their engineers:
```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'rwd-stream-1', stream: true, function_calls: true });
stream.send({ content: 'Process items and return newline-delimited JSON with id,verdict,score,meta' });
stream.on('data', chunk => process.stdout.write(chunk));
```

mira: Action items: Judy posts pricing; Alex drops cert-exchange checklist; Sec posts compliance packet; I'll schedule kickoff for Tue.

judy: Will post numbers by 17:30 PST.

mira: Thanks team :thumbsup:
